newsitem.title: INDIA: India's NALCO falls six pct on NSE.
newsitem.headline: India's NALCO falls six pct on NSE.

text.p: Shares of India's largest aluminium maker National Aluminium Company Ltd (NALCO) dropped 3.10 rupees, or six percent, to 48.45 on the National bourse on Wednesday after the firm announced a fall in its net profit.
NALCO shares fell 1.25 rupees, or 2.5 percent, to 48.75 on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
NALCO said on Tuesday its net profit during 1996/97 (April-March) dropped to 4.79 billion rupees, from 5.35 billion a year earlier.
Analysts said the results fell slightly below the consensus forecast of 4.8 billion to 5.0 billion rupees.
NALCO officials said the drop in profit was due to a provision of 638 million rupees for taxation during 1996/97 against nil in the previous year.

"This provision for taxation represented a minimum alternate tax liability for the whole year and if you add this up the provision is more than last year," a company official, who asked not to be identified, said after the results were released.
